prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: corrected clean left near-orthographic provider input for high-quality multi-view 3D reconstruction
Input images: Image 1 is the rejected left-view edit target. Preserve its creature identity, exact one-head/two-ear/nine-tail anatomy, body proportions, tail fan geometry, fur pattern, materials, camera height, gray background, lighting and framing.
Primary request: change only the leg stance and the minimum adjacent body pixels needed to expose all four complete anatomical leg chains and all four paws. Add/reveal the currently hidden far foreleg as a natural shoulder-to-elbow-to-carpal-to-paw chain, placed one small paw-length forward of the near foreleg. Keep the two hind paws similarly offset. The result must still read as a left near-orthographic reconstruction view, not a dramatic three-quarter view.
Subject invariants: one non-humanoid fox head, two upright ears, two eyes, exactly two forelegs, exactly two hindlegs, exactly four paws, exactly nine full-volume tails. Preserve each of the nine existing tails from a continuous sacral/caudal attachment to one tip; do not add, delete, branch, merge, cross, shorten or restyle any tail. All four paws rest on the same invisible ground line.
Composition/framing: complete body with generous margins; each leg and paw separately traceable; no crop or perspective convergence
Lighting/mood: unchanged uniform neutral studio illumination
Constraints: change only the stance visibility defect; keep identity, material, background and nine-tail fan unchanged; no text, labels, arrows, cast shadow, horizon or watermark
Avoid: a fifth leg, tail-like leg, hidden far foreleg, merged paws, extra/fused/missing tails, anatomy drift, body-proportion drift, perspective, motion blur, fog, depth of field, smooth clay or plastic fur
negative_prompt: hidden far foreleg, only three paws, extra limb, fifth leg, tail-like leg, merged paws, extra/fused/missing tails, fewer or more than nine tails, anatomy drift, crop, perspective, shadow, horizon, text, watermark
notes: Passed original-resolution and 200-percent reference QC: one head, two ears, two forelegs, two hindlegs, four separate grounded paws and nine independently traceable full tails; cross-view consistency confirmed against view 004.
